overlay.resources.menu.instructions_body:
These tools use the current account session and do not upload tokens.

Each tap runs one resource operation. Inventory sync checks the result before and after the operation. Cards are topped up to four copies. Purchases stop when too many packs are unopened.
overlay.resources.menu.instructions_long:
These tools use the current account session and do not upload tokens.

Each tap runs once, with inventory sync checks before and after.

Cards are topped up to four copies. Purchases stop when too many packs are unopened. If you see HTTP 401, stop and sign in again.
